# Scenario: per-route cert config + project-level defaults.
# Project config cert-issue-type: none applies to the port route (no route config);
# domain route overrides with mock → self-signed HTTPS + :80→:443 redirect.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: proxies per-route cert'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'cert issued name=e2e-admin\.apinfra\.test mode=mock'
! stderr 'cert issued name=port-8333'
stderr 'done duration='
! stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-admin-console

exists $HOME/infra/mockcerts/e2e-admin.apinfra.test/fullchain.pem

# Port route inherits project default none → plain HTTP.
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8333/
stdout 'ADMIN_OK'
! exec curl -skf --max-time 3 https://127.0.0.1:8333/

# Domain route mock → TLS + :80 redirect.
exec curl -skf --resolve e2e-admin.apinfra.test:443:127.0.0.1 https://e2e-admin.apinfra.test/
stdout 'ADMIN_OK'
exec curl -sI --resolve e2e-admin.apinfra.test:80:127.0.0.1 http://e2e-admin.apinfra.test/
stdout '301'

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-admin
    enabled: true
    proxies:
      - inbound:
          port: 8333
        target:
          service:
            name: console
            port: 80
        # inherits projects[].config cert-issue-type: none
      - inbound:
          domain-name: e2e-admin.apinfra.test
        target:
          service:
            name: console
            port: 80
        config:
          cert-issue-type: mock
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-admin/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  console:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=ADMIN_OK"]

-- .env --
